itinerary.title: The coast: El Alamein and the desert war
itinerary.source: The first evening is sunset at Fatnas Island on Birket Siwa — a salt lake with a single palm-shaded island — and dinner in town.

itinerary.title: Siwa: the oracle, the lakes, the sand sea
itinerary.overnight: desert camp or one of Siwa's eco-lodges
itinerary.source: Sunset Bedouin tea at the dune edge, a barbecue dinner, and an overnight at a desert camp or one of Siwa's eco-lodges (Adrère Amellal or Talist, depending on availability).

itinerary.title: The return: Shali, the dead, and the coast
itinerary.source: From Siwa the route turns north again to Marsa Matrouh on the Mediterranean — beaches the colour the postcard would suggest — and east along the coast back to Alexandria by evening.
